STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_01128_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_01128_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_01128 (
	clk,
	rst,
	rx,
	tx,
	transmit,
	tx_byte,
	received,
	rx_byte,
	is_receiving,
	is_transmitting,
	recv_error
);
	input clk;
	input rst;
	input rx;
	output tx;
	input transmit;
	input [7:0] tx_byte;
	output received;
	output [7:0] rx_byte;
	output is_receiving;
	output is_transmitting;
	output recv_error;

	parameter CLOCK_DIVIDE = 43;
	parameter RX_IDLE = 0;
	parameter RX_CHECK_START = 1;
	parameter RX_READ_BITS = 2;
	parameter RX_CHECK_STOP = 3;
	parameter RX_DELAY_RESTART = 4;
	parameter RX_ERROR = 5;
	parameter RX_RECEIVED = 6;
	parameter TX_IDLE = 0;
	parameter TX_SENDING = 1;
	parameter TX_DELAY_RESTART = 2;

	reg [10:0] rx_clk_divider;
	reg [10:0] tx_clk_divider;
	reg [2:0] recv_state;
	reg [5:0] rx_countdown;
	reg [3:0] rx_bits_remaining;
	reg [7:0] rx_data;
	reg tx_out;
	reg [1:0] tx_state;
	reg [5:0] tx_countdown;
	reg [3:0] tx_bits_remaining;
	reg [7:0] tx_data;

	assign received = (recv_state == RX_RECEIVED);
	assign recv_error = (recv_state == RX_ERROR);
	assign is_receiving = (recv_state != RX_IDLE);
	assign rx_byte = rx_data;
	assign tx = tx_out;
	assign is_transmitting = (tx_state != TX_IDLE);

	initial begin
		rx_clk_divider = CLOCK_DIVIDE;
		tx_clk_divider = CLOCK_DIVIDE;
		recv_state = RX_IDLE;
		tx_out = 1'b1;
		tx_state = TX_IDLE;
	end

	always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
		if (rst) begin
			recv_state <= RX_IDLE;
			tx_state <= TX_IDLE;
		end else begin
			rx_clk_divider <= rx_clk_divider - 1;
			if (rx_clk_divider == 0) begin
				rx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
				rx_countdown <= rx_countdown - 1;
			end

			tx_clk_divider <= tx_clk_divider - 1;
			if (tx_clk_divider == 0) begin
				tx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
				tx_countdown <= tx_countdown - 1;
			end

			case (recv_state)
				RX_IDLE: begin
					if (rx == 0) begin
						rx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
						rx_countdown <= 2;
						recv_state <= RX_CHECK_START;
					end
				end

				RX_CHECK_START: begin
					if (rx_countdown == 0) begin
						if (rx == 0) begin
							rx_countdown <= 4;
							rx_bits_remaining <= 8;
							recv_state <= RX_READ_BITS;
						end else begin
							recv_state <= RX_ERROR;
						end
					end
				end

				RX_READ_BITS: begin
					if (rx_countdown == 0) begin
						rx_data <= {rx, rx_data[7:1]};
						rx_countdown <= 4;
						rx_bits_remaining <= rx_bits_remaining - 1;
						if (rx_bits_remaining == 0)
							recv_state <= RX_CHECK_STOP;
					end
				end

				RX_CHECK_STOP: begin
					if (rx_countdown == 0) begin
						if (rx == 1)
							recv_state <= RX_RECEIVED;
						else
							recv_state <= RX_ERROR;
					end
				end

				RX_DELAY_RESTART: begin
					if (rx_countdown == 0)
						recv_state <= RX_IDLE;
				end

				RX_ERROR: begin
					rx_countdown <= 8;
					recv_state <= RX_DELAY_RESTART;
				end

				RX_RECEIVED: begin
					recv_state <= RX_IDLE;
				end
			endcase

			case (tx_state)
				TX_IDLE: begin
					if (transmit) begin
						tx_data <= tx_byte;
						tx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
						tx_countdown <= 4;
						tx_out <= 0;
						tx_bits_remaining <= 8;
						tx_state <= TX_SENDING;
					end
				end

				TX_SENDING: begin
					if (tx_countdown == 0) begin
						if (tx_bits_remaining != 0) begin
							tx_bits_remaining <= tx_bits_remaining - 1;
							tx_out <= tx_data[0];
							tx_data <= {1'b0, tx_data[7:1]};
							tx_countdown <= 4;
						end else begin
							tx_out <= 1;
							tx_countdown <= 8;
							tx_state <= TX_DELAY_RESTART;
						end
					end
				end

				TX_DELAY_RESTART: begin
					if (tx_countdown == 0)
						tx_state <= TX_IDLE;
				end
			endcase
		end
	end
endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name rtlpp_01128.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.
